frames.method: For each retained emitted source section, sum immediate TSC/SBC/TCS reservations and all static push sites at 16-bit width, plus three bytes at each call/tail edge. This overcounts disjoint branches. Compiler-balanced loops reuse their stack. Cross-call and cross-function tail sharing are disabled. Typed callbacks and finite action contexts are audited below; new indirect sites or cycles reject the report.
frames.limit: Source-frame bound only. The continuation cap includes bridge and library/native/GEM work below an application call; executed startup/lifecycle chains check that cap separately. Editing/dialog/file paths must establish it when implemented; current samples are not a bound on those future paths.
contexts: Legacy path/Save selector callers pass NULL; the multi-file callback is retired
Native deletion follows the outer asynchronous decision; saving borrows a frozen ring
Linked new_edit/restore_edit use Open or unchecked Delete
wi_top invokes disabled Update, whose test returns false
